description:
Cast Starfall Invocation by paying {3}{W}{W}, choosing to promise an opponent a gift.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Starfall Invocation.
Resolve Starfall Invocation, causing an opponent to draw a card, then destroying all creatures and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
